exposure: Clinical characteristics and outcomes in pregnancy
Psychological impacts of the pandemic on pregnant women
outcome: Clinical features of COVID-19 in pregnancy
finding: This bibliometric analysis of publications related to COVID-19 and pregnancy found that the clinical features of COVID-19 during pregnancy are generally similar to those of infected nonpregnant women, with a slight increase in preterm and cesarean birth rates associated with severe maternal illness.
mod_finding: There is a small increase in frequency of preterm birth and cesarean birth, related to severe maternal illness.
